description: This file defines internal structures, constants, and function prototypes for Trust Token cryptographic operations in BoringSSL, including key management, token issuance, unblinding, and testing functions for various cryptographic schemes using P-384 curve.

classes.name: TRUST_TOKEN_CLIENT_KEY
classes.description: Structure representing a Trust Token client key with public components.

classes.name: TRUST_TOKEN_ISSUER_KEY
classes.description: Structure representing a Trust Token issuer key with private components.

classes.name: TRUST_TOKEN_PRETOKEN
classes.description: Intermediate state structure during Trust Token issuance.

classes.name: trust_token_method_st
classes.description: Structure of function pointers defining cryptographic operations for Trust Tokens.

classes.name: trust_token_client_key_st
classes.description: Structure pairing key ID with a client key.

classes.name: trust_token_issuer_key_st
classes.description: Structure pairing key ID with an issuer key.

classes.name: trust_token_client_st
classes.description: Structure representing a Trust Token client with keys and state.

classes.name: trust_token_issuer_st
classes.description: Structure representing a Trust Token issuer with keys and state.

methods.name: TRUST_TOKEN_PRETOKEN_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a TRUST_TOKEN_PRETOKEN.
